LanguageData.ZCNCL_ReadingMessageDescription: Independent of sound. Only new Reading desire activations; multiple children in one scan share one message. No pop-up letter or forced pause.
LanguageData.ZCNCL_ShowLearningPercent: Show Learning number instead of portrait name
LanguageData.ZCNCL_LearningPercentDescription: Children only; displays 0-100 (floored). Does not change pawn names.
LanguageData.ZCNCL_LearningNumberSizeDescription: 100% (default) / 125% / 150%. New 100% keeps the previous default text size; large text may overlap on very small colonist bars.
LanguageData.ZCNCL_HighlightLearningDescription: Includes learning at 100%; color fades about 120 ticks after learning stops.
LanguageData.ZCNCL_AutoWakeDescription: Only sleeping, undrafted children. Medical beds, downed pawns and mental breaks are excluded.
LanguageData.ZCNCL_MinimumRestDescription: Minimum Rest can be set to 38.0% or higher. Medical safety checks remain active.
LanguageData.ZCNCL_WakeCooldownDescription: 0 hours removes the successful-wake cooldown; failed-attempt safeguards remain.
LanguageData.ZCNCL_EarlyWakeDescription: If vanilla selects Sleep again, an early wake may wait until Learning is below 90%. This setting initiates a wake attempt; it does not guarantee staying awake.
LanguageData.ZCNCL_AutoEatDescription: Does not interrupt the current job; prioritizes meals when choosing the next job.
LanguageData.ZCNCL_LegacyEatDescription: Old wake-only option retained for existing saves. EF1 supersedes this option while independent eating is enabled.
LanguageData.ZCNCL_ConfirmRestoreDefaults: Restore defaults for this tab only? The other tab is unchanged.
LanguageData.ZCNCL_ConfirmDisableFeatures: Disable features in this tab only? Saved values and the other tab remain unchanged.
LanguageData.ZCNCL_IconPreviewDisclaimer: Illustration only. No real learning desire is changed.
LanguageData.ZCNCL_GizmoDescription: Control allowed learning-assist features for this child. Global settings always take precedence.
LanguageData.ZCNCL_GizmoGlobalNote: Global permission: if enabled here, each child can still toggle the feature with its own gizmo.
LanguageData.ZCNCL_GizmoReadingDescription:
A notification appears when a reading learning desire becomes active.
A reading icon appears on the child's portrait while the desire is active.
LanguageData.ZCNCL_GizmoWakeDescription:
When a sleeping child's Learning is at or below {0}%, the mod attempts to wake them.
You can review the conditions for auto-wake in the mod settings.
You can change the Learning threshold in the mod settings.
LanguageData.ZCNCL_GizmoFoodDescription:
Children with a Food level of {0}% or lower go to eat.
You can review the conditions for automatic eating in the mod settings.
You can change the Food threshold in the mod settings.
LanguageData.ZCNCL_GizmoDefaultsScope: New children only. Existing children keep their settings. Global OFF hides the corresponding gizmo.
LanguageData.ZCNCL_GizmoDefaultReadingHint: Includes reading icon, sound and activation message. Each global setting must also allow its part.
LanguageData.ZCNCL_GizmoDefaultWakeHint: New children do not receive automatic wake-up unless enabled here or with their individual gizmo.
LanguageData.ZCNCL_GizmoDefaultFoodHint: Vanilla automatic eating remains active when this is OFF.
LanguageData.ZCNCL_GizmoDefaultsGlobalPriority: Global feature switches always take precedence. Changing these defaults never changes existing children.
LanguageData.ZCNCL_ConfirmRestoreGizmoDefaults: Restore new-child gizmo defaults to Reading ON, Wake OFF and Food OFF? Existing children are unchanged.
LanguageData.ZCNCL_WakeSummaryLearning: Sleeping children attempt to wake when their Learning is {0}% or lower.
LanguageData.ZCNCL_WakeSummaryRest: Auto-wake only activates when the child’s Rest is at least {0}%.
LanguageData.ZCNCL_WakeSummaryCooldown: After a successful auto-wake, a {0}-hour in-game cooldown applies. Further auto-wake attempts for that child are restricted during this cooldown.
LanguageData.ZCNCL_WakeSummaryCooldownZero: There is no timed cooldown after a successful auto-wake. Failed-attempt retry safeguards still apply.
LanguageData.ZCNCL_FoodSummaryStart: Children with a Food level of {0}% or lower go to eat.
LanguageData.ZCNCL_FoodSummaryNoInterrupt: Auto-eating does not interrupt the child’s current activity (learning, work, sleep, etc.).
LanguageData.ZCNCL_FoodSummaryQueuedCommands: Auto-eating does not take priority over queued commands.
LanguageData.ZCNCL_FoodSummaryPolicy: Auto-eating follows the food policy. Only foods permitted by the food policy are selected.
LanguageData.ZCNCL_GrowthGizmoLearningDesires: Show current learning desire icons above the vanilla growth gizmo
